description: This file defines a class for running Pylint code quality tests within an Odoo module, including executing Pylint on Python files in a given directory and processing the results.

classes.name: quality_test
classes.description: A class that performs Pylint code quality checks on Python files within an Odoo module.

methods.description: Formats the Pylint results into a table for display.
